howItWorksSteps.title: 01. Invest across any of the 333 fleet units
howItWorksSteps.body: Invest in any active fleet unit or robot as much as your wallet balance allows—you can lease more than two fleet units simultaneously. Minimum crypto deposit starts at the price of the least expensive active fleet unit.

howItWorksSteps.title: 02. Fund via Binance crypto & collect daily yields
howItWorksSteps.body: Register, complete KYC verification, select from 16 Binance-supported coins, and submit your TXID or screenshot. Once Finance approves your deposit, activate units to earn live daily returns.

howItWorksSteps.title: 03. Same-day yield withdrawals & payout rules
